articles.title: Ibiza House Reinterprets Traditional Way of Living
articles.summary: Studio Metamorphosis designed a vacation home in Ibiza that reinterprets traditional living. The design centers shade, landscape, and shared spaces. It reflects the island's memorable inhabited places.

articles.title: Blu Pizzeria Jeddah Blends Wind and Design
articles.summary: MOVS Studio designed the Blu pizzeria in Jeddah around the wind shaping the port. The restaurant features a curved glazed facade. It occupies a 335-square-meter corner unit.

articles.title: Shenzhen Bay MixC Phase II Opens as Social Retail
articles.summary: The second phase of Shenzhen Bay MixC shifts retail toward mixed-use social and cultural spaces. Ippolito Fleitz Group designed the project as infrastructure becoming experience. It continues evolving shopping malls globally.

articles.title: Mirador House Rotates to Capture Ocean View
articles.summary: The Mirador House rotates to capture the view and shields itself from wind. It adapts to a steep hillside in Chile. Rodrigo de la Cerda Arquitecto designed this innovative residence.

articles.title: Dam House Follows Natural Topography
articles.summary: The Dam House is set on a site with a large elevation drop toward a reservoir. It is organized across three stepped terraces. 24 7 Arquitetura designed it to connect architecture, topography, and landscape.

articles.title: Casa LDM Blends House with Lake
articles.summary: Casa LDM sits on elevated topography near Palmira with open views. The L-shaped lake partially surrounds the house. HILADA Arquitectos designed the residence.

articles.title: Rana House Brings Villa to Suburban Plot
articles.summary: The Rana House was designed for a 1960s subdivision in Portugal. It responds to a housing type common in suburban outskirts. STUDIO_LPP completed the project.

articles.title: Parkside Villa Renovates Boulder Family Home
articles.summary: Studio B Architecture + Interiors transformed an existing Boulder home for an active family. The project focused on renovation rather than demolition. It reimagined the residence for changing lifestyle.

articles.title: Beijing Seniors Apartment Redefined by DAGA
articles.summary: DAGA Architects designed a neighborhood elderly apartment in Beijing. The project redefines old-age housing for poor and elderly residents. It contains 4,500 square meters of space.

articles.title: Hangzhou Vanke Times Commune Breaks Typology
articles.summary: The Hangzhou Vanke Times Commune is located near Alibaba's campus. Its building is divided vertically into public and residential zones. DAGA Architects designed the shared community space.

articles.title: Beijing Intangible Heritage Workstation Opens
articles.summary: DAGA Architects designed a workstation in ancient Qianzhou. The project supports intangible cultural heritage in Xiangxi. It is located by the Wanrong River.

articles.title: Fusion Creative Workshop Blends Wood and Nature
articles.summary: The Fusion Creative Workshop is a Faculty of Wood Engineering building. It is located in a botanical garden at University of Sopron. ARCHI.DOC prioritized old and new, built and natural design.

articles.title: Aery Office Chair Offers Adjustable Fit
